# improve git add

Silence the hint that a bare `git add` prints:

```
$ git add
Nothing specified, nothing added.
hint: Maybe you wanted to say 'git add .'?
hint: Turn this message off by running
hint: "git config advice.addEmptyPathspec false"
```

Git's own suggestion — `advice.addEmptyPathspec false` — belongs in [git_config](../../bin/git_config) with the other advice and behaviour settings.
